verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a user-configurable concurrency cap or rate limit scoped per workflow, per key, or per tenant. The closest items are adjacent and do not deliver the story: rate limits that Temporal Cloud itself enforces to keep the service reliable, and general guidance on tuning Workers and Task Queue processing.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I cap concurrency and set rate limits per workflow, per key, or per tenant so one hot customer can't starve the rest
